# Local Dependencies

- Three.js 0.169.0: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r169, MIT license.
- OrbitControls, GLTFExporter and TextureUtils come from the same Three.js version.
- GLTFExporter has one local-path adjustment: `../utils/TextureUtils.js` to `./TextureUtils.js`.
- Lucide 0.468.0: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/tree/0.468.0, ISC license, with inherited Feather icon licensing in the upstream LICENSE.

The bundled library source and its existing license header are retained. License texts are supplied alongside these dependencies when retrieved from their official distribution.
